task: Install, inspect, downgrade, and remove each optional adapter without damaging unrelated configuration.
material_claims: Adapters are opt-in and own only marked registrations and generated payloads.

files.content:
# Optional adapters
Adapters are opt-in and remove only Self-Evolution-owned entries.

required.description: Verify that init enables no adapter or generated hook payload.
Install, inspect, downgrade, repeat, and remove each supported adapter.
Preserve unrelated provider, theme, hook, MCP, and plugin configuration through the lifecycle.

forbidden.description: Enable an adapter or hook during default initialization.
Replace or delete unrelated user-owned configuration.
